bagPolicy.summary: Only bags whose largest side is no larger than a DIN A4 sheet are permitted, such as belt bags, gym bags, and tote bags. Larger bags, backpacks, and helmets may have to be placed in paid storage.
allowed: bags no larger than DIN A4 on the longest side
bagPolicy.note: Entry includes more thorough security screening. Bring only what you need.

parking.note: Parking is available at the 'Überseering' in the City Nord, which is about a 5-10 minute walk from the venue. No specific pricing information is provided. Consider using public transportation as the event ticket includes an HVV ticket.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Stadtpark Open Air's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Stadtpark Open Air varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: There is a wheelchair platform. Wheelchair tickets are limited, sold only in advance through the official ticket service, and not available at the box office. If they sell out, wheelchair users can still enter with a regular ticket but are not guaranteed a spot on the platform.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not allowed. If you leave the venue during the concert, your scanned ticket will not get you back in.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Stadtpark Open Air. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entry begins no later than one hour before the event; for sold-out concerts the venue says entry can begin about 90 minutes before the show.
